dialogue.origin: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちはこちらこそよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: これから、すぐ始めますかいかがいたしましょうか
dialogue.content: Shall we begin right away?

dialogue.origin: 始めて大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: それでは、始めます
dialogue.content: Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です。本日は、いかがされましたか
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは最近学校行きたくないんです
dialogue.content: Hello. Lately, I haven't been wanting to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれはお辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 最近、行きたくないと思われたきっかけは、心当たりありますか
dialogue.content: Do you have any sense of what might have triggered these feelings recently?

dialogue.origin: やる気が起きない
dialogue.content: I just don't feel motivated.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be hard.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんな時に、やる気が出ないですか
dialogue.content: Are there specific times when you feel unmotivated?

dialogue.origin: 何をやってもやる気がでないです
dialogue.content: I don't feel motivated to do anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお困りですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be troubling for you.

dialogue.origin: 自分でも何でかわからない
dialogue.content: I don't even know why myself.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 食事や睡眠は、きちんととれていますか
dialogue.content: Are you able to eat and sleep properly?

dialogue.origin: 夜更かしが多くなった気がする食事はちゃんととれてます
dialogue.content: I feel like I've been staying up late more often. I am eating properly, though.

dialogue.origin: 何時に寝て、何時ごろ、起きますか
dialogue.content: What time do you usually go to bed and what time do you wake up?

dialogue.origin: 12時頃寝て7時頃起きます
dialogue.content: I go to bed around midnight and wake up around seven.

dialogue.origin: 夜更かしは、どのようなことをされていますか
dialogue.content: What do you usually do when you stay up late?

dialogue.origin: 友達とLINEとかゲームかな
dialogue.content: I guess I text with friends on LINE or play games.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは、お疲れですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be tiring.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: Well, maybe so.

dialogue.origin: 他には、何か、趣味をお持ちですか
dialogue.content: Do you have any other hobbies?

dialogue.origin: テニスです
dialogue.content: Tennis.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねテニス、良いですね
dialogue.content: I see. Tennis is great, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 楽しいです
dialogue.content: It's fun.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそれは、良かったです
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s good to hear.

dialogue.origin: でも今はできないんで
dialogue.content: But I can't do it right now.

dialogue.origin: どうしてですか
dialogue.content: Why is that?

dialogue.origin: 部活休みなんです
dialogue.content: My club activities are on hold.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね寂しいですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be disappointing.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どうして、休みなんですか
dialogue.content: Why are they on hold?

dialogue.origin: コロナの関係です
dialogue.content: It's because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね嫌ですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That's frustrating, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: すると、今は、ずっと家にいるのですかそれとも、外には出ておられるんですか
dialogue.content: So, are you at home most of the time now, or are you able to go out?

dialogue.origin: 学校には週3回行ってますそれ以外は家です
dialogue.content: I go to school three days a week. Otherwise, I’m at home.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 学校では、どんなことをされていますか
dialogue.content: What do you usually do at school?

dialogue.origin: 授業受けるだけです
dialogue.content: I just attend classes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね座ってばかりだと、息が詰まりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. Sitting all the time can feel stifling, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 人と騒いでいけないって先生から言われるんで
dialogue.content: The teachers tell us not to socialize or make a lot of noise with other people.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれも、もどかしいですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be frustrating as well.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 何年生ですか
dialogue.content: What grade are you in?

dialogue.origin: 高1です
dialogue.content: I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご自身では、どんなことが、やる気がしないと、何か感じること、心当たりは、ありますか
dialogue.content: Do you have any sense yourself of what might be behind your lack of motivation?

dialogue.origin: せっかく受験頑張って高校入ったのに、入学式もない。学校行っても勉強だけ。つまんない
dialogue.content: I worked so hard on my entrance exams to get into high school, but there wasn't even an entrance ceremony. When I go to school, it's just studying. It's so boring.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは、つまらないですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That does sound boring.

dialogue.origin: 週3だから友達もほとんどできない
dialogue.content: Since I only go three days a week, I can't really make any friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね友達も、出来づらいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be difficult to make friends in that situation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何とお呼びしたらよろしいですか
dialogue.content: What would you like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: ようこです
dialogue.content: Yoko.

dialogue.origin: ようこさん、高校に、入学して、学校生活をとても楽しみにしていたのに、入学式もなく、友達も、出来ずらくて、とても悔しいですね
dialogue.content: Yoko, it sounds like you were really looking forward to high school life, but with no entrance ceremony and it being hard to make friends, it must be very disappointing for you.

dialogue.origin: とても、悲しいことと思います
dialogue.content: I imagine that’s very sad for you.

dialogue.origin: 悔しくはないかな
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if "disappointed" is the right word.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: とにかくつまらないです
dialogue.content: More than anything, it's just boring.

dialogue.origin: つまらないのですね
dialogue.content: So it feels boring.

dialogue.origin: そのつまらなさから、悲しくて、寂しくて、心細くて、何にもやる気がしないのと思います
dialogue.content: I imagine that this boredom makes you feel sad, lonely, and helpless, and that's why you don't feel motivated to do anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね
dialogue.content: I wonder if that's it.

dialogue.origin: ゲームをやったり、友達と、ラインをやるのも、その心を埋める気持ちなのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Perhaps playing games and texting with your friends on LINE is a way to fill that void.

dialogue.origin: もともとゲームは好きなんで
dialogue.content: Well, I've always liked games.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ようこさんは、学校生活を、とても頑張って有意義な学校生活にしようと頑張っている、とても努力家の方だと思います
dialogue.content: Yoko, I think you're a very hard-working person who is trying your best to have a meaningful school life.

dialogue.origin: いや、そんな訳でも。。。ただ普通に学校通いたいです
dialogue.content: No, not really... I just want to go to school normally.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 学校を通いたいと思っているということは、一生懸命、学校生活を送りたいということだと思いますが、いかがですか
dialogue.content: The fact that you want to go to school makes me think that you want to put your best effort into your school life. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: 一生懸命って感じでもないです
dialogue.content: I wouldn’t say “earnestly.”

dialogue.origin: 家に帰ってからの楽しみは、何かありませんか
dialogue.content: Is there anything you look forward to after you get home from school?

dialogue.origin: ゲームとLINE
dialogue.content: Games and LINE.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それでは、ゲームとラインを、一番の楽しみにされて、ようこさんのご褒美とされては、いかかでしょうかそして、学校生活の足りない部分を、家で補うのも、良いと思いますが、いかがですか
dialogue.content: In that case, how about you make games and LINE your main enjoyment, like a reward for yourself? And perhaps it would be good to supplement the parts that are missing from school life at home. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 高校1年生と言えば、進路の勉強もあると思います
dialogue.content: And as a first-year high school student, I imagine you also have studies related to your future career path.

dialogue.origin: よくわかりません
dialogue.content: I'm not really sure about that.

dialogue.origin: どうしてですか
dialogue.content: What makes you say that?

dialogue.origin: 勉強は好きではないです
dialogue.content: I don’t like studying.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どうな勉強が好きですか
dialogue.content: Are there any kinds of study you do like?

dialogue.origin: 勉強は嫌いです
dialogue.content: I hate studying.

dialogue.origin: どんな科目が、好きですか
dialogue.content: What subjects do you like?

dialogue.origin: 体育、美術
dialogue.content: P.E. and art.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね良いですね
dialogue.content: I see. That's great.

dialogue.origin: 家で、体を動かしてみたり、好きな絵を、描いてみるのも、気分転換になって、良いですよね
dialogue.content: Trying to do some physical activity at home, or drawing pictures you like, could be a nice change of pace, don't you think?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行けなくて、つまらないと思われますが、家で、体を動かしてみたり、絵を描いたりして見てくださいきっと、楽しみが、増えることと思います
dialogue.content: I know you feel bored because you can't go to school properly, but please try doing some exercise or drawing at home. I'm sure you'll find more things to enjoy.

dialogue.origin: やる気も、改善できますよね
dialogue.content: That could help improve your motivation, too.

dialogue.origin: まずは、少しづつ、始めましょう
dialogue.content: First, let's start with small steps.

dialogue.origin: ゆっくり、ゆっくり、始めましょう
dialogue.content: Let's start slowly, nice and easy.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、続くかわかんないけど
dialogue.content: Well, I don't know if I can keep it up.

dialogue.origin: そのうちに、日常生活が、少しづつ、やりたいことで、満ちてくると思います
dialogue.content: In time, I believe your daily life will gradually become filled with things you want to do.

dialogue.origin: 今はそう思えない
dialogue.content: I can't imagine that right now.

dialogue.origin: コロナ疲れも、ありますが、夜は、ゆっくり休んでください
dialogue.content: Pandemic fatigue is real, so please rest well at night.

dialogue.origin: そうおもえないのは、どうしてですか
dialogue.content: Why is it that you can't imagine that?

dialogue.origin: コロナ長く続きそうだから
dialogue.content: Because it seems like COVID will go on for a long time.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 息抜きも、必要ですよね
dialogue.content: It's important to take a break and relax, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 息抜きの場がない
dialogue.content: I don't have a place to unwind.

dialogue.origin: 外を、散歩してみるのは、いかがですか
dialogue.content: How about taking a walk outside?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I suppose.

dialogue.origin: 外の綺麗な空気を吸って、ぜひ、息抜きをしながら、楽しんで、生活してみてください
dialogue.content: Please try to get some fresh air outside, take a break, and find enjoyment in your daily life.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、やってみます
dialogue.content: Well, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: そうですねようこさんなら、きっと出来ます
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm sure you can do it, Yoko.

dialogue.origin: 心から応援しています
dialogue.content: I'm rooting for you with all my heart.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: そうですよ
dialogue.content: I do.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい、お祈りしています
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll be hoping for the best for you.

dialogue.origin: 応援していますきっと大丈夫です
dialogue.content: I'm supporting you. I'm sure it will be okay.

dialogue.origin: そんなこと言われても、自信ないけど、まあ、やってみます
dialogue.content: Even if you say that, I'm not confident, but... well, I'll try.

dialogue.origin: はい、頑張ってみてください
dialogue.content: Yes, please give it a try.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 何か、他には、ありますか
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you’d like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: いえ、ないです
dialogue.content: No, that’s all.

dialogue.origin: ようこさん、本日は、ご相談、ありがとうございますやってみて、いかがでしたでしょうか
dialogue.content: Yoko, thank you for coming in for counseling today. How was it for you?

dialogue.origin: 1人でもんもんとしてたんで、誰かに話せて良かったです
dialogue.content: I was just stewing in my thoughts by myself, so it was good to talk to someone.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、良かったですありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: これで、終了させていただきます
dialogue.content: We'll conclude our session here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: モンティーさん、本日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Monty, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: ロールプレイを、終了しますありがとうございます
dialogue.content: This concludes the role-play. Thank you.

topic.sub: 高校生活の楽しみの欠如
